value.reason: After two-factor login, the auth token is saved to localStorage under the key 'token' (two-factor-auth-enter.component.ts:54). The HTTP request interceptor then reads it back from localStorage and sends it as a «SECRET» header (request.interceptor.ts:16). Any script running on the page's origin can read localStorage, so an XSS bug or a malicious third-party script could steal the token. The data_flow shows the same pattern in the login, OAuth and payment components too. The token is a reusable credential that is not scoped to the session, and the code matches the positive example exactly. That makes this insecure storage of sensitive information. Because the token gives access to user accounts and their personal data, it also falls short of reasonable security safeguards.
